subject: Choosing cabinet finishes and handles
hook: Kitchen finishes and handles chosen with you in Stoke-on-Trent
gbp:
Bespoke kitchens in Stoke-on-Trent, with finishes and handles chosen in your own home.

The door finish and handles set the character of a kitchen, so we help you choose them where they will actually live: in your room, in your light, next to your floor.

Finishes available include matt, super matt, gloss, wood-effect and painted looks, in colours such as oak-effect, charcoal, black woodgrain, matt white and matt black. Handles come in antique gold or matt black, or you can choose a handleless look. Soft-close hinges and runners are standard.

Our process is straightforward. A free, no-obligation design consultation, with samples brought to you. A measured survey and an itemised quote with transparent pricing and no hidden costs. Manufacture in our own Hanley workshop, quality-checked before it leaves. Delivery and installation by our own team.

It suits anyone planning a new kitchen in the new year who wants to see real samples before committing.

Book your design consultation.
